summary.text: Jerry O'Connor is a Republican member of the Wisconsin Assembly representing District 60, based in Fond du Lac, and has been elected to the Assembly since 2022.
He chairs the Committee on Ways and Means and is vice-chair of the Committee on Corrections.

paragraphs.text: O'Connor was born in Lone Rock, Wisconsin, on September 14, 1953, and is married with five children and six grandchildren.

He graduated from Madison West High School in 1971, studied pastoral studies at Minnesota Bible College in 1973, and received a diploma from the University of Wisconsin-Madison School of Banking in 2001.
The Legislature's page describes him as a retired bank CEO and board chair, a former licensed real estate broker and insurance agent, and a real estate developer.
He is a former co-chair of the Wisconsin Bankers Association board and a former chair of the Community Bankers of Wisconsin board.
His listed memberships include the Fond du Lac Noon Rotary Club and the treasurer role on the executive board of Envision Greater Fond du Lac, e-Center for Hope and Vision.
